feature: Share a conversation's summary or audio, never its transcript

scenarios.name: Offer only the summaries and audio a conversation has
scenarios.given: a conversation may have a full summary, a Quick summary, transcript or notes, and saved audio
scenarios.when: the user opens Share for it
scenarios.then: Full summary, Quick summary and Audio are offered in that order, each only when it has something to send; the transcript and notes are never offered, and blank summaries are not offered

scenarios.name: A summary is shared without the transcript or notes
scenarios.given: a conversation has a full summary, a Quick summary, notes and transcript
scenarios.when: the user shares Full summary or Quick summary
scenarios.then: the share sheet receives readable text with only the title, recording date and the chosen summary, and Audio sends the saved files instead of text

scenarios.name: Every Share entry point opens the share sheet with a summary
scenarios.given: a saved conversation with summaries is open, or listed in History
scenarios.when: the user chooses More → Share → Full summary, or swipes a History row and taps Share, or touches and holds the row
scenarios.then: the system share sheet opens with the summary and Copy pastes readable summary text with no transcript or notes; the touch-and-hold menu offers Share

scenarios.name: A plain Share sends the summary
scenarios.given: a conversation has a full summary, a Quick summary or neither
scenarios.when: the user shares it without choosing (History swipe Share or the VoiceOver Share action)
scenarios.then: the full summary is sent, else the Quick summary; with no summary there is no plain Share and nothing is sent
